semantic.justification: Actual comphelper date.hxx/date.cxx forward and inverse year/day counting, validity, leap/month and normalization algorithms preserve source integer division, condition order, BCE traversal, signed16 clamping, empty/valid returns, year-zero skipping, month-driven signed16 narrowing and day-overflow clamps. DateFields projects the original three addressed uint16/uint16/int16 values. The native assert-enabled month/year preconditions are explicit. CALC275-276 preserve suspicious BCE direction/month-year wrap. The common 1899-12-30 day number and normalizing conversion follow date.cxx. Broader calendar APIs remain unported.
